# Repute India AI

> Repute India AI is a software and AI company serving businesses across India, UAE, East Africa, UK and worldwide. It builds websites, CRMs, custom business systems, mobile apps, AI agents and WhatsApp automation for businesses, and runs "Get Found in AI Search", a monthly service that gets a business named when customers ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity or Google for a recommendation.

## Services

- Website Development
- CRM Development
- Custom Business Systems (ERP-style)
- Get Found in AI Search (AI search visibility)
- Mobile Apps (Android and iOS)
- AI Agents (multilingual, in the customer's language)
- WhatsApp Automation
- Reputation Management (Google reviews)
- Business Process Automation
- E-commerce

## Get Found in AI Search — plans (India, per month)

- Found: ₹4,999 per month, one-time setup ₹7,000. 10 buyer questions tracked, 15 profiles, 2 articles a month, monthly AI Visibility Report.
- Featured: ₹12,999 per month, one-time setup ₹12,000. 25 buyer questions tracked, 30 profiles, 4 articles a month, 1 third-party placement a month, monthly report and call.
- Authority: ₹29,999 per month, one-time setup ₹20,000. 50 buyer questions plus 3 competitors tracked, 40+ profiles, 8 articles a month, 3 third-party placements a month plus quarterly PR, fortnightly report and call.
- Minimum term is 6 months, because AI answers usually take 3 to 6 months to change.
- Local-currency pricing is also available for the UAE, the UK, Australia and the USA.
- East Africa (Kenya, Tanzania, Uganda): US$59, US$119 and US$209 per month for Found, Featured and Authority. Payment by bank transfer or card, M-Pesa on request.
- No ranking is guaranteed. No fake reviews, made-up awards or unlabelled paid placements.
